name: mechcheck for Overleaf
description: Mechanical checks for LaTeX theses and papers, inside Overleaf. Nothing leaves your machine except the reference lookups you switch on.
//host_permissions: The overleaf entries let the content script load. The three APIs are fetched
from the service worker, which is the only place a Manifest V3 extension may
make cross-origin requests -- and the reason reference verification works here
but not in a sandboxed web page.
